records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our revenue increased by $20.5 million, or 12.8%, to $180.1 million for the three months ended December 30, 2022, from $159.6 million for the three months ended December 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •continued growth in the demand for high-performance analog, digital and optical semiconductors in our three primary markets;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, cash used in operating assets and liabilities was $23.8 million for the three months ended December 30, 2022, primarily driven by an increase in accounts receivable of $10.5 million, an increase in inventories of $6.4 million and a decrease of $10.3 million in accrued and other liabilities, partially offset by an increase in accounts payable of $3.7 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was 61.3% and 59.0% for the three months ended December 30, 2022 and December 31, 2021, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Adjustments to reconcile our net income to cash provided by operating activities primarily included a net gain of $114.9 million related to the sale of our equity method investment offset by equity method investment losses, depreciation and intangible amortization expense of $15.2 million and share-based compensation expense of $9.9 million.
